_what: Every retrospective harness pair this project has RECORDED, in the order it recorded them. Amendment A4 (iv) states the same list in reports/epl_sim_amendments.md, and epl/tests/test_simretro.py fails if the two diverge. `run_retro` refuses to start under a pair that is not here unless allow_unrecorded_harness=True, which is stamped on every row the run writes and printed in the report; a run that used it is not a citable run.
_why_a_data_file: The list cannot live inside epl/simretro.py: appending a version there would change the file's own SHA-256 and invalidate the entry being appended. It lives beside the harness instead, and the harness reads it.
